# proxmox_node_ceph_config_index (Data Source)

Reads default Ceph configuration entries as JSON from `GET /nodes/{node}/ceph/cfg`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_ceph_config_index" "pve" {
  node = "pve"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)

### Read-Only

- `config` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
